text: Third attempt at getting through to someone. My granddaughter, 4, is with me tonight. Temperature 38.2 at 9pm. Sore throat, but she's drinking her juice no problem. She's had runny poos twice this evening. Still drinking well and she's done plenty of wees, I've been keeping an eye on that. She is not floppy or anything. She's wide awake on the sofa watching her programme and telling me all about it, bossy as ever. Her mother wants to know if she needs bringing in or if we just carry on at home. A straight answer would be appreciated.
